items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: He played the dream room and every cell used to come at the famous door to see me. That's how close we were.

ctx.x: He took off that money and we went to get a trombone. You know when Jack Teagarden, when he died here? Yeah. He checked in Prince County and he threw his grip there in the lobby, told the bar to bring it up and came to the famous door. He played the dream room and every cell used to come at the famous door to see me. That's how close we were.
And what was he playing when he came here? He looked at the dream room. No, no, no. Before when he was a kid. No, he wasn't going to play music. Oh, he was playing.
